title: OverSire actions
description: Typed writes that the app or the cloud sends to an adapter.

ActionKind.description: The risk of an action in the action catalog. read: allow. change: ask once in each chat. outward: ask each time. settings: the assistant never runs it.

ItemPatch.description: A write to a tracker item. A missing field stays as it is.

LaunchRequest.description: Start an agent in a runtime workspace.

repo.description: Repo path or remote URL in the runtime.

name.description: The workspace name. Default: the item key.

note.description: The workspace note. Default: the item URL.

agent.description: Same raw values as the AgentBinder Harness: claude, codex, opencode, cursor.

environment.description: Deprecated. The daemon ignores it: each daemon runs sessions only on its own machine.

command.description: The resolved shell command that starts the agent in a terminal runtime. Empty: the runtime default. The first word is the agent program.

title.description: The terminal title. Default: the agent name.

baseBranch.description: The branch that a new workspace starts from. Default: the runtime default.

inPlace.description: True: open a new terminal in the folder repo. The runtime makes no workspace and ignores name, note, branch and baseBranch.

key.description: The start key. The daemon starts at most one live session for each key. A start with the key of a live session gives that session. Example: enhance:OVERSIRE-317.

model.description: The vendor model id, for example claude-opus-5-5. Missing: the CLI default. A terminal runtime adds it as a flag, unless command has the flag already.

effort.description: The reasoning effort. Open set: low, medium, high, max. Missing: the CLI default.

profile.description: The OverSire agent name, for example claude-max. Display only: agent stays the base CLI.

RelationKind.description: The kind of a relation, seen from the item that holds it. A blocks B is the same relation as B blockedBy A. The tracker keeps the relations: OverSire keeps no second graph. A duplicate B: A tells the same problem as B, and B stays. Schema 2 added duplicate (Groom, OVERSIRE-336).

RelationPatch.description: A write to the relations of one item. The adapter adds before it removes.
